tei:div.tei:p: ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i byung tshul lo/ /

'gro ba'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan sa skya pas/ /chol kha gsum la kha lo bsgyur pa'i dus/ /de yi 'phrin las sgrub pa'i dpon chen dang*/ /slob dpon dge bshes blon rje rim pa rnams/ /mkhas pa mchog stobs grangs las 'das mod kyis/ /thog mar yus po che ba'i mi gsum po/ /grom pa'i sa skya dpon rje shāka bzang dang*/ /shar smad tsong kha'i dge bshes rin brtson dang*/ /mdo stod go 'jo'i hor chen don tshul yin/ /de gsum nang nas rigs mtho blo gsal ba| |dge bshes chen po nas brgyud ding sang bar/ /bla ma'i zhabs tog dbus gtsang bya ba dang*/ /mi mthun dpung 'joms ma sangs bka' babs zhes/ /snyan pa'i grags pas phyogs bcu kun khyab pa/ /blon chen 'di pa'i byon tshul 'di ltar ro/ /de yang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon bod du chos skyong rgyal po khri srong lde btsan dang*/ de'i sras bzhi pa/ khri lde srong btsan rgyal po'i sku ring la/ mtha'i dmag 'gog pa'i bod yul gyi phyogs bzhir/ sgo srung bskos/ khyad par bod dmag khri khrag mang po khyer nas/ bha ta hor gyi sgom grwa bcom/ g.yul rgyal/ gnang bcad nas phyir byon dus/ de phyogs kyi sgau srung la/ bod dmag gseb nas skyen btus pa'i dpa' bo mi dgu dmag brgya phrag dgu dang bcas pa hor bod kyi so mtshams su bzhag de dus khong rnams kyi/ nged rnams ji tsam la log rgyu yin zhus pas/ rgyal po'i lung gi nged kyi bka' ma byung bar la log rgyu med gsungs pas/ de phyin pas dpa' bo mi dgu'i rus ling bka' ma log zer bar chags te/ der yun ring bas/ bka' ma log gi bod 'brog sde tshan mang po yod/ se chen rgyal po'i blon chen sang gha ching sang zer ba de'ang*/ rus bka' ma log tshang yin zer ba 'dug de rnams kyi chad rgyud las chad pa/ shar tsong kha mtsho sngon gyi mthil na/ skad gsar ba bya ba dang*/ bya rong ba bcu dgu mer bya ba dang*/ yul khams chen po gsum gyi bdag po yang zangs ring mo'i sras che ba/

skya ming dbon po rin chen rgyal mtshan zhes pa/ blo gsal zhing skye mched dwangs pa zhig byung ba/ de nyid gzhon nu nas dkar po'i phyogs la mos pa zhig yod pas/ yul khams rnams mched zla kun 'dzin du bcug nas/ gtsang sa skya bla ma'i snyan grags tshor/ mos gus bcug te/ zhabs la gtug par 'dod nas yar byon te/ mdo stod kyi hor chen ston tshul yang*/ chos don du gnyer ba la/ sngon la 'bri gung du byon/ der ma bsten/ sa skyar chas pa dang*/ khong rnam gnyis gya ba lung par mjal/ mdo stod smad kyi phyogs srid dang*/ sku tshe sngon ma'i 'brel shugs kyis/ spun phu nu ltar thugs shin tu mthun par byung nas/ de'i dbyar gya ba 'brong ngu dgon par bsdad/ ston de 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa gong nas yar phebs dus/ 'brong ngu dgon pa bas gdan drangs/ bsnyen bkur zhus/ de thog tu khong rnam gnyis pas kyang mjal/ rab byung zhus/ dbon po'i mtshan rin chen brtson 'grus bya bar btags/ bdag slob gnyer mthil phyin pa zhig byed 'dod pas/ rjes su bzung du gsol zhus pas/ de bzhin legs/ slob dpon shar pa ye shes rin chen gyi slob gnyer gyi 'go 'don gyis la/ dge bshes chen po zhig mgyogs par yong bar byed do gsungs nas/ dge bshes la snga ba rin chen brtson 'grus zer ba'ang*/ de dus nas byung bar gda'o/ /de gnyis ka'i phyag phyir byon/ sa skyar phebs/ slob gnyer mdzad pas/ shes rab dang*/ thugs rus che ba'i tshad thub par byung nas/ ring por ma lon par sa skya'i dge bshes rnams kyi nang nas/ mkhas grags thon par byung*/ bar skabs nas bla ma 'phags pa'i phyag phyi zhabs tog mthil bzhugs yun ring mdzad/ bya ba'i ljid khur chen po mang du gal/ de mtshams sa 'bri 'khrug pa'i 'go tshugs/ gong du khrims kyi gtug bsher la phyogs phyogs nas mi drag pa 'gro dgos pa byung dus/ dpon chen shākya bzang po dang*/

dge bshes rin chen brtson 'grus/ rin po che ston tshul gsum po'i bla ma dang*/ bstan pa gdan sa chen pos phyis la bsam te/ blos blangs nas byon/ khrims lugs su song bas/ tshal gung thang nas/ pho brang shang rdo'i bar la/ an khur nas rkang thang la byon/ gong du gtug bsher legs/ sa skya pa'i bya ba rnams la gang 'dod legs par grub nas/ yar 'khor dus khong rnams sa skya ba la/ yus che ba'i mi gsum du grags par byung zhing*/ chen por gyur/ spyi sgaus su bla ma'i gnang sbyin/ brgya stong so so'i bya dga' chen po byas/ khyad par dge bshes chen po la/ ja rin la sa skya'i drug cha ma'i 'dab sgo dang*/ tshong dus khang leb kyi 'go byas/ grā sa khang ga ra phu'i gyog gzhis ka rnams gtsang mar gnang*/ skya btsun thams cad kyi bkur sti zhabs tog che bar byung*/ de'i skabs su mched grogs ston tshul ba'i gros la slob gnyer gyi bka' spyad byas/ dge bshes kyi snyan grags ni thob/ sa skyas gsang sngags zab mo'i bdag po yin pas/ da yang gsang sngags dang mthun par mdzad na sku khams kyi 'tsho skyong du'ang 'gyur la/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su/ bu slob rjes 'dzin sogs la'ang khyad che bar yong zer ba la gsan nas myang stong byed mda' ba/ ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum mngon chung ngus gyog gzhis ka ru bzhagaphyag rgya bsten pa la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba ban rgan blo gros rin chen/ bar pa dharma dkon mchog chung pa dpon kun dga' rdo rje rnams byung*/ bar pa 'di 'gro mgon phyag na'i sras/ dharma pha la rakṣi ta dang*/ lo zla zhag dus mnyam du 'khrungs pa na/ mtshan 'di chos rgyal 'phags pas btags par byed do/ /de'i dus su rgyal bu chos dpal/ bod 'chos pa la byon pas/ bsu skyel zhabs taug la dge bshes chen po de bas/ 'bad rtsol skyes pas/ nyi ma nub phyogs kyi bya ba rnams legs par grub nas phyir byon dus/ sog sa mdo bar skyel thung la byon par rgyal bu mnyes nas/

byang re thag phyir than gang 'dug rin chen brtson 'grus mi rgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug cing*/ khyed kyi shed mong 'dab pa bzhin du bu tsha bo rnams kyis kyang*/ gong ma yon mchod la shed mong 'dab chug zer ba'i/ lung ji bzang po gnang*/ de nas dge bshes chen po/ sa skya'i tshong dus khang leb tu zhi bar gshegs rting*/ sras che ba ban rgan pas/ yab kyi rjes su zhugs nas khrims kyi bya ba dang*/ sa skya pa'i zhabs tog nang so'i mthil len/ dgos su bla ma bdag nyid chen po'i zhabs la gtug shed mong gdab/ ta tu'i pho brang du byon pas/ bla ma'i sku drin la/ o la ja du rgyal po'i lung lha rgod mdung rtse yan nas/ dwangs ra g.yu mtsho man 'di/ blo gros rin chen rgyud pa dang bcas pa shes su bcug pa'i 'ja' sa gtsang ma gnang*/ gcung gnyis po nye ring med par bskyangs/ gcen la byang gi khri dpon dang*/ gcung la du dben shī'i las ka zhus nas bskos/ dharma dkon mchog gi gzhis pa la/ ma gcig mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi nye gnas ma zhig dang*/ dpon kun rdor rje la ma gcig bsod 'bum gyi tsha mo zhig blangs nas/ gnyis ka la sras ma byung*/ ban rgan pas zhal ta mdzad/ zhal ta ma re re 'og tu bzhag pa las/ khri dpon dharma dkon mchog la sras khri dpon chos rgyal dang*/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po byung*/ du dben sha kun dga' rdo rje la sras/ khri dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan byung*/ khri dpon chos rgyal gyis/ yab kyi shul du byang ru'i khri dpon thog gcig mdzad nas sku gshegs so/ /sras med pas dkon mchog rgyal mtshan khri dpon la bskos/ bla chen kun blo'i phyag phyir gong la byon/ yar jau mo sreg shing dbon mo bslangs nas/ mthong smon sa cha/ lha khang spang grong gi kha 'dzin byed dus/ sras bzhi byung ba'i che ba dpon po dkon mchog 'od zer dang*/ dkon mchog rin chen/ mkhan po bsod nams blo gros/ chung ba rgod po rin chen rnams byung ngo*/

/gcung po 'di ma sangs kyi sprul pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'di'i skabs su dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po de nyid/ 'brog khri skor gyi ru thog mtsho mo ru khyung gi skor nas sgar chen bzhugs dus/ chibs pa ston chen bya ba zhig bor nas/ lha 'dre mi gsum la lca hu bkrams/ rtsad gcod pa phyogs bzhir btang bas/ shar phyogs pa mi gnyis kyis kha ba skya sribs babs pa'i steng la rta rjes 'dug pa/ mthar ded pas sog la skya bo'i zhol na/ sgar chen zhig 'dugade'i khrod na chibs pa yang 'dug nas/ mgron mnyer ba la rgyu mtshan bshad/ sgar 'di su'i yin bris pas/ ma sangs gyi sgar yin/ ge sar dang rgu ld-i la sogs pa yod zer/ gur nang du khrid/ rgu ld-i yin zer ba de na re/ nged kyi kha sing nas byang stong la yong*/ dpon chen pa dang mjal rtsis la ma mjal/ da gzod khyed kyi dpon po zhig yod pa de dang*/ yang yang 'phrad zer ba gyis la/ rta dang mda' rgod sgro ma 'di phul zer nas khyer yong*/ dpon chen pa la phul/ der rting dpon po rgod po rin chen 'khrungs so/ /dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po de nyid/ ti shri kun rgyal ba'i zhabs la gtugagong la phyag phyir byon/ bla ma'i sku drin dang*/ khrims kyi bya ba la mkhas pas/ sngon la dbon shri dang*/ der rting du dbus gtsang gi dpon chen sngun ma thob/ yar phebs dus rgan pas zhal ta mdzad/ jo mor bla ma mus chen po'i dbon mo dang*/ dpon mo jo mo rim par blangs na'ang*/ sras ma byung ba/ zhal ta ma 'bum rgyan bya ba la sras grags pa rgyal mtshan pa byung zhing*/ rting la sras zur du dbon po hor tsha bya ba zhig yang byung*/ dpon chen pas dbon po dkon mchog 'od zer byang khri dpon la bskos/ sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pa sa skya nang sor bzhagadabus gtsang bde ba la bkod nas/ dbon po dkon mchog rin chen pa phyag phyir khrid te/ yang gong ma yon mchod kyi zhabs drung du byon pa/

sngon rting dril bas lo bco brgyad tsam gong du bzhugs/ son jing dben gyi rtsa ba'i dpon chen lo zhang lan gsum mdzad/ lung gu ta ha'i zon gnang*/ yar 'byon khar nga'i sbra ber khyung gsum gyi tshong pa/ bod la lo re bzhin yong ba'i 'babs sa'i gnas gzhi zhig brtsigs dgos zhus pas/ gang 'os tshol gsungs pa la/ shangs na e mar sgang rgyud nas sa che bar 'dug pas 'di dgos zhus pas/ gye re babs la gdong yan/ thag ma ngal gdong*/ nyang ri shi cig man gyi sa cha/ rgyal ba bzang po'i rta sga 'bogs la byin cing*/ de khongs gang 'os su gnas gzhi brtsig tu chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po gnang bas/ yar phebs nas shangs mthong smon gyi sa cha 'di na/ klu gnas pa'i rdzing zhig 'dug pas/ ming dang gang sa nas rten 'brel la legs pas/ 'di khongs su chug pa gyis gsungs lcags ri/ dpe lcog rnams kyi dkyil du khang leb chen mo dang bcas par btab/ der rting gong ma yon mchod kyi sku rim smon lam 'debs shing*/ spos bsregs pa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs su bcug dgos zer ba'i zhu ba gong du btang bas/ de bzhin yin chug gsungs pa'i lung phebs nas/ nyug rgyal khang rgyal po'i pho brang la dpe blangs na bzhengs/ chos sde 'di sngon bod rgyal blon bzhugs dus kyi bka' bstsal rnying pa dang*/ ram sding ma bas dgon lag rnying pa da cha med pa zhig 'dug pa'ang*/ dpon chen pas rgyal khang bzhengs pa dang mnyam du/ sa paṇḍi ta 'jigs med grags pa/ chos dpon la gdan drangs/ dgos kyi mnga' zhabs la btsun khral thengs gnyis rgyab nas bshad grwa btsugs/ chos sde'i shed mong skyed/ chos khrims dar bar mdzad cing*/ yab yum gyi phyi bstan la/ g.ye mar sgang stod du/ sku 'bum chen mo bzhengs/ zha lu bu ston rin po che gdan drangs nas/ rab gnas dbus gtsang du rgyas pa'i dpe thub pa mdzad/ lung gi bskaus pa'i dpon chen gnyis/ byang sa'i phyag tshab cig dang bcas pas/

gong du dbus gtsang dang*/ dpon chen thengs gsum mdzad pas/ de bar la gdan sa chen mo'i zhabs tog bla ma la bkur sti/ mnga' zhabs kyi skyong thar/ phag gru khri dpon dang*/ khams pa la sogs khrims 'gal mu med byed mi rnams la/ drag las kyi 'jun 'dul/ gzhan yang rgyal khrims chen po'i bya ba la'ang*/ nye ring med cing blang dor ma 'dzol bar byung bas/ kun gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dpon chen du grags shing*/ gong nas rting ma phebs rjes la/ sras blo gros rgyal mtshan pa byung ba/ gcen dpon chen grags rgyal dang*/ dgung lo bcu bdun bco brgyad kyi khyad yod pas na/ grags rgyal ba'i sras yin par byed pa yang yod la/ khong gnyis kyi bar du dpon po hor tshas dpon thog tu lo gcig gnyis bzhugs zer ba'ang gleng*/ dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po bas/ khrims gnyis kyi bya ba dpon chen dbang brtson la 'phrod pa'i skabs su/ lha rtse'i gzims khang lho mar bde bar gshegs nas/ spur bzhu dus/ thugs ljags dang bcas te byon pa de/ gzims khang gung rigs la/ chos rgyal 'phags pa'i sku 'dra yod pa/ de'i thugs kar thim pa kun gyi mthun snang du grub bo/ /phyis skor gyi dpon chen la/ 'di nyid bla ma la gus zhing khrims gnyis kyi bya ba la mkhas par byed do/ /dpon chen pa'i sras po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas/ sngon sa skya nang chen bzung*/ rting la dpon chen gyi ming thob/ shang mthong smon bzung ba'i skabs der sku gshegs so/ /gcung po dpon po hor tsha'i sras/ sna dkar ba dpon kun dga' rgyal po rgyud chad/ blo gros rgyal mtshan pas/ si tu'i ming dang las ka thob/ dpon chen pas dbon po 'di dang*/ mthong smon sbrags nas ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la sprad/ gtsang phyogs kyi sde pa dar lcog dkar po 'dzugs pa'i sngon ma byas zer ba 'dug 'di'i ring la mthong smon pad chen bzhengs/ sgo pad zur lcaug rnams kyi kha sgron/

'bor lcags chung bzos so/ /de'i sras bzhi pa'i che ba du dben sha byang chub rgyal ba dpal bzang po'ang*/ ldog thung du grags pa/ thugs rgod cing rtsal skyen pas/ de'i ring la rdzong shang dang*/ phyi nang gi sde 'khrug mang*/ de 'og mkhan po kun dga' blo gros pas/ nyug chos sde'i mkhan po mdzad/ de 'og tu dben sha kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas/ rgyal mthong bzung kun dang mthun pa'i lugs shas che bar byung*/ gcung po chung ba dpon po kun dga' rdo rje bas/ du dban sha kun rgyal bas gdung rgyud lcam mo blangs pa la sras shig 'khrungs pa/ du dben sha rin chen rgyal po sku brtan par bzhugs pa'o/ khri dpon dkon mchog 'od zer bas byang ru thog gi khri dpon mdzad cing*/ dpon po dkon mchog rin chen dang*/ rgod po rin chen pas/ nyug rgyal khang mgo byas/ bres sna la sogs 'dzin/ mkhan po bsod nams blo gros pas zhang po'i gdan sa sreg shing gi mkhan po mdzad pa'i dus su/ mthong smon na yang/ dpon chen grags rgyal ba yod pas/ dpon skya g.yog rigs ky-i dbang du song nas shangs pa nang ma bde/ dpon po sku mched che ba gnyis sku gshegs rting dpon po rgod po rin chen pas/ stag tshang rdzong khar bla chen bsod blo sku mched pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ rgyab bcol nas rdzong blang sde gzar rgyun ring*/ dgung lo bco brgyad pa la bla chen gyi phyag phyir mkhan chen g.yas ru pas byas nas/ gong la byon bla ma'i bka' drin la/ tho gon thi mur rgyal pos/ phing gcig pa'i mi dpon srid swan jing dben gyi hu shri'i mtshan dang*/ dam rtags/ ban rgan blo gros rin chen pa'i dus su/ ji ltar gnang ba bzhin gyi bod 'brog dbang rigs rnams/ rgod po rin chen du hu shri mi rgyud dang bcas pa shes su chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po dang bcas pa gnang*/ yar phebs bla ma sku mched pas zhabs tog sde pa stag tshang rdzong kha'i phyi'i dgra 'dul dmag dpon gyi bya ba gang la'ang*/

sde pa'i mtshan jus gtso bor ston pas/ dpon sa nas kyang thag rta nag gi gnyer pa gnang*/ sna dmar rdzong brtsigs/ shangs pa nang ltar gyi sde gsar 'pho 'jug mang na'ang phyi nang sus kyang rgol bar ma nus pa/ rgod pa'i snyan grags shin tu che zhing*/ me pho stag lo rdzong stag sna don grub rtse bzung ste/ de'i char gtaugs pa'i mnga' zhabs bod 'brog mang du chod nas/ da lta'i bar la brtan cing 'phel ba dang bcas pa'o// de la yum mi gcig pa'i sras bu gsum byung pa'i che ba/ rta nag pa dpon po shākya rin chen/ ngam rings pa rgyal ba rin chen/ chung ba skyor mo ba sog po rin chen rnams te/ shākya rin chen pas/ yab kyi gnyer las kyi rjes rta nag bzung*/ de la sras dug tsher rin chen dang*/ nam mkha' rin chen/ dge sbyong dkar por grags pa rnams so/ /rgyal ba rin chen la sras/ rnam rgyal rin chen dang*/ dpal ldan rin chen byung*/ gnyis ka yab kyi sngon la 'das so/ /sog po rin chen pas/ lha bu rin mkhar zer khong lam rdzong gsar brtsigs/ sras rgyal bu rin chen pa dang*/ dge sbyong bsod nams rin chen pa/ grags pa rin chen pa rnams byung ngo*/ khri dpon dkon mchog 'od zer ba/ sku mched phyogs gcig pa'i dus kyi sras po gcig byung ba/ drung chen glang po rin chen de nyid/ yab grongs pa'i rjes la stag tshang rdzong khar 'khrungs/ dpon po dang bla brang dang*/ mtsho skyong 'go 'don yang dag mdzad/ cher skyes nas dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan pas zhal mthong*/ dbang rnam sras pa'i zhabs la gtugs/ gzim dpon mdzad/ khu dbon phyogs gcig tu dril nas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong*/ dpon po'i zhabs tog buddha'i sog rum skyong thar/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba la shin tu mkhas shing*/ thugs rtsol che bar grags pas phyogs kun tu khyab bo/ khyad par dbus pa bdag po grags pa rgyal mtshan pas phag mo gru ba'i srid la gtogs pa'i dbus gtsang gi dmag dpung stobs che ba bsdus nas/

me pho khyi lo'i ston stag sna rdzong la bskor rgyag yun ring byas/ nang yan 'tshag skyel bred sdig ji snyed cig byung na'ang*/ yab sras dpon g.yog rnams kyi legs par sra bcas/ phur btsugs/ 'thab rol sprad pas dbus gtsang du mkhraigs pa'i tshad thub pa byung zhing*/ stag shar gtsang srid du grags pa'i 'go de nas tshugs pa yin/ sa skya pa'i srid jus yar 'phel du song ba blon chen de nyid kyi thugs zhen dang*/ 'phrin las la brten pa'o/ /de'i sras lnga'i che ba/ drung chen nam mkha' rin chen pa ni/ sku gzhon nu nas klaug yig la sogs bslab shes kyi yon tan mtha' dgasngon du phyogs nas/ mi dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan pa dang*/ mes po ho shri chen po'i zhabs la gtugs/ gsol ja bzung*/ pho rtsal sna dgu skur skyong 'grogs lam sde srid 'dzin pa'i bya ba la yon tan sgor mor 'dzoms pas kun gyi ma sangs kyi sprul par 'dzin cing*/ khyad par khyi lo dmag chen gyi lo rdzong gi dus rtse zhol bsrung ba gang khag pa thams cad du phebs nas/ sgyaugs mda' rdo'i gnad sprad pas shin tu ngo mtshar du gyur te/ phyis nas gdong len gyi mi su yang med pa byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang dmag che chung mtha' rogs snga phyi mang po'i 'go ma la byon pa/ dus nam yang gdong phud ngor lang kho na mdzad cing*/ phyi skor bya ba gang la'ang*/ brtan lhing gtsau bor 'don pas/ phyi nang kun gyis 'di ni dpa' mdzangs 'dzoms pa'i skyes bu chen po yin zhes grags so/ /de'i gcung po rgya bzang rin chen/ rgya mtsho rin chen/ nor bu rin chen/ grub pa rin chen rnams yin/ gcung 'di'i rdzong rang 'byon rtse bzung*/ mtshar zhan bod 'brog kun gsar du chod do/ /gcen gyi khab tu gdung rgyud lcam mo/ byang sems nam mkha' rgyal po ba byon pa'i sras che ba chos rgyal rin chen mched gsum te/ sku mched khu dbon zhal ngo mang la hrags pa/ sku brtan par bzhugs pa lags so/

/blon chen che rgyud ma sangs sprul pa'i rigs/ kha drag mi dpung 'dzoms pa 'khor bcas 'dis/ /phas rgol mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba dang*/ /dpal 'byor yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas gyur cig /dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /pho rtsal sna dgu ni mtheb kyi sha non pa dang gcig rkyal gyis chu non pa/ yang sor bya lta bu dang gsum la dpa' shed lus kyi rtsal gsum zer/ lo rgyus kyi dge yon thon pa dang*/ 'gran shags kyi lce non pa dang*/ khyom tshos bzhad gad thon pa dang gsum la smra ba ngag gi rtsal gsum zer/ dpa' la brtan tshugs pa dang gcigamadzangs la blo myur ba dang gnyis/ go gsal la gting sus kyang mi rtaugs pa dag gsum la/ blo gros sems kyi rtsal gsum zer/ pho rtsal sna dgu ni/ mda' rdo mchongs gsum/ sho phras rtsis gsum/ bang shags rkyal gsum dang dgu'o// pho rtsal sna dgu 'di 'dzom na ma sangs sprul par byed do// /
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ rgyal rabs mang po'i legs bshad rnam grangs yid 'dzin nor bu'i phreng ba/ma sangs sprul pa stag sna rdzong pa'i byung tshul/ -PAGE 214--PAGE 223--PAGE 213-
